limitations: I preserve the first missing-companion failure and distinguish its two actual assertions from old zero-assertion failures.

I retain files present at terminal, exact command streams, source and providers; original cleanup removes some intermediate generated C, snapshots and intentionally replaced publication artifacts. I do not claim those deleted intermediate bytes are archived.

Copied complete fresh providers precede actual Make companion builds, which may rebuild timestamp-dependent objects. The ordinary reference image is the copied qualified image; the private image links the recorded post-build provider closure with the existing private factory.
Loaded-library maps are a bounded private-parent observation. They are not a trace of every dynamic load or every operating-system header.
